description: This Java class implements the CreditReportWritePlatformService interface, providing methods to get, add, save, and delete credit reports related to credit bureaus, specifically handling integration with ThitsaWorks credit bureau. It manages database interactions, validation, and exception handling within the Fineract credit bureau infrastructure.

classes.name: CreditReportWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing credit report operations, including retrieval, addition, saving, and deletion of credit reports, with integration support for ThitsaWorks credit bureau.

methods.name: getCreditReport
methods.description: Retrieves a credit report from the specified credit bureau, currently supporting ThitsaWorks integration.

methods.name: addCreditReport
methods.description: Adds a new credit report for a given credit bureau, specifically handling ThitsaWorks.

methods.name: saveCreditReport
methods.description: Saves a fetched credit report into the database, replacing existing report for the same national ID if present.

methods.name: deleteCreditReport
methods.description: Deletes a credit report based on credit bureau ID and national ID.

methods.name: getCreditBureauName
methods.description: Fetches the name of the credit bureau given its ID, with validation.

methods.name: handleTokenDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity issues by mapping exceptions to appropriate error responses.
